sources: https://midnrreservations.com/ (Clear Lake State Park resources via the booking site's /api/resourcelocation/resources and /api/resource/feeDetails for 2026-10-27, 2027-05-18, 2027-06-15 and 2027-09-21; audit/state_park_fees/gtc_probe.py, read 2026-10-22)

values.note: 2027 on the booking site (same on 2027-05-18, 06-15 and 09-21): 20/30-amp sites $34 (135 sites), 50-amp sites $39 (40). The DNR's 2026 table: modern $32 (20/30 A) / $37 (50 A), semi-modern $27 / $32 while the toilet/shower building is closed (outside May 15 - Oct 14); the booking site charged $27 / $32 on 2026-10-27. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to all state park campgrounds.

fees.source: https://midnrreservations.com/ feeDetails per fee schedule ($34 for the 20/30-amp sites, $39 for the 50-amp sites on 2027-05-18 / 2027-06-15 / 2027-09-21; $27 / $32 on 2026-10-27) + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates (Clear Lake Upper and Lower Campgrounds: $37 / $32 modern, $32 / $27 semi-modern; shower building May 15 to Oct. 14) + https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/clearlake ('A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://midnrreservations.com/ site attributes (40 sites 'Electrical Service=20 Amps/30 Amps/50 Amps', 135 sites '20 Amps/30 Amps'; every public site 'Electric and Water Hookups=Electric Only', 'Sewer Hookup=No') + https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/clearlake ('Some campsites with 50-amp service'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 178 sites in the Upper and Lower loops (the booking site lists 175 public campsites plus a host site), shaded by oaks and pines; equipment lists run to 'Trailer or RV up to 40''. The DNR page says there are 'several pull-through sites', but the booking site marks none as pull-through.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/clearlake ('Number of sites: 178'; 'divided into two loops, the upper and lower loops, with several pull-through sites') + midnrreservations.com equipment lists and 'Pull Through=No' per site, read 2026-10-22

values.note: Sanitation station (two lanes, potable water) just inside the modern campground; closed Oct. 19 - Nov. 2, 2026 for wastewater upgrades (water stays available at park headquarters).

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/clearlake (amenities 'Toilet & shower building, Vault toilet, Sanitation station'; 'The park's sanitation station is located just inside the modern campground. There is potable water available and two lanes'; notice 'Clear Lake State Park's sanitation station will temporarily close Oct. 19-Nov. 2 to accommodate wastewater system upgrades'), read 2026-10-22

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/clearlake ('Clear Lake Modern Campground: For reservations call 800-447-2757 or reserve online', linking https://www.midnrreservations.com/), read 2026-10-22

summary: DNR park page + booking site: 178 sites, 20/30 A everywhere and 50 A at 40, electric only (no water or sewer at sites), equipment to 40 ft, shower building, vault toilets, sanitation station (closed Oct 19 - Nov 2, 2026), reservable online or by phone. Fees 27-37 (2026 DNR table) -> 34-39 (2027 booking site; 2026 semi-modern $27/$32 in the note). Pull-through not written: the DNR page says 'several', the booking site marks none. Season year-round already manual. --AWH note kept unchanged.
flags: Missing operator website and phone: the entry links only the bare reservation home page (https://midnrreservations.com/) and has no phone. The park's DNR page is https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/clearlake; park phone 989-785-4388 (reservations 800-447-2757).
